description: Crawl statistics, average AI-readiness score, llms.txt coverage and document counts for one site. The connection block says how the site is connected: plugin or app, whether live pages can be changed (WordPress plugin, SFTP / FTP files or not at all) and where the Markdown copies are served (next to each page in the customer domain, on the customer subdomain, or under an Anole address). Read it before promising a change to the live site.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.
